Two fixes for JD Highlighter. It idles quietly again on a narrow window, and the log stays readable after a start.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **JD Highlighter no longer keeps about 1.7 cores busy at idle.** When JD's window was narrower than its toolbar's contents, for example 1024x768 with `JD_UI_SCALE=2`, the toolbar was laid out again on every pass, which queued the next pass straight away, about 900 times a second. The toolbar is now only realigned when it is actually out of place, and the container idles at a few percent. [@mmenanno](https://github.com/mmenanno) tracked this down in [#65](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/jdownloader/issues/65) and sent the fix in [#66](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/jdownloader/pull/66).
- **The log no longer fills with `restored light theme icon` lines.** After a start, the mono icon recolour and the agent took turns rewriting the package toggle and column lock icons, and each round logged four lines every five seconds. The recolour now leaves those four icons to the agent. Thanks to [@Kayn2106](https://github.com/Kayn2106) for reporting it in [#63](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/jdownloader/issues/63).
